versions.name: Camp Pine Mountain
versions.summary: A Chattahoochee Council camp near West Point on the Georgia–Alabama line, serving as a day camp and weekend camping property with a swimming pool, cabins, and small lakes for packs, troops, and camporees.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Chattahoochee Council camp-properties page, which lists Camp Pine Mountain as one of three current council camps and describes it as a day camp and Cub Scout overnight/weekend property near West Point. The scout-camp-map street address (Camp Pine Mountain Road) could not be verified and was not recorded. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's camp-properties page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a day/weekend camping property; features unsurveyed.
